대상 장치에서 정상 촬영과 미완료 요청이 있는 상태에서의 정지를 각각 시.approved: First, test normal capture on your target device. In a separate test, stop capture while requests are still pending. For each request you submit, count its completion callbacks and record that count along with the request status and the status of each buffer. Check whether the request was canceled. Then check each frame to see whether it was captured successfully. See {{1}}.
